verdict.rationale: Unleash documents a Docker-based guide for running Unleash Open Source in your own environment (docs-4), and its GitHub repository is the open-source distribution (gh-1). Edge acts as a read replica in which targeting PII is processed locally and never sent upstream (docs-5, docs-35), which supports keeping evaluation data on your own infrastructure. Some capabilities, such as custom roles and the 'Enterprise Edge' naming, appear tied to Enterprise or hosted tiers, so the open-source distribution may not be the full platform (docs-32, docs-28, gh-3). Missing for 10: confirmation that the full feature set (RBAC, change requests, SSO, Edge) ships in the open-source distribution, detailed self-host architecture and data-residency documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosting.
